title: Using e-learning tools to enhance students-mathematicians' competences in the context of international academic mobility programmes
reason: Compares competence-mastery scores and motivation change between a target group using a multilingual Math-Bridge course (14) and a control group (8); no per-student platform activity measure enters any analysis.

extraction.population: Russian-speaking master's students in 'Optimization Methods', Kazan National Research Technical University (KAI)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: competence mastery score; interest/motivation in mathematics
extraction.notes: English text (Integration of Education, international section); Cyrillic only in metadata and references. Groups of 14 and 8 students; no inferential statistics.
